metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented the simulator in `output/` using Rust 2021 with no external dependencies.

Release build succeeds; all 31 tests pass.

```bash
cargo run --release --manifest-path output/Cargo.toml -- \
  --input program.ngc --output result.json
```

See [README.md](/workspace/output/README.md) for tracing and optional arguments.
